rules.description: Coordinate changes across frontend and backend
rules.instruction: When making changes, update both frontend and backend as needed. Ensure API contracts are maintained.
Document API changes. Update TypeScript types to match backend responses. Test end-to-end flows.
Test API calls from frontend. Verify error handling. Check loading states. Ensure proper data flow.
Coordinate schema changes with API updates. Update migrations. Test with real data.
Ensure frontend and backend versions are compatible. Update compose files together.

rules.description: Ensure consistent error handling across layers
rules.instruction: Backend returns structured errors. Frontend displays user-friendly messages. Log errors appropriately.
Update OpenAPI/Swagger docs. Keep README current. Document breaking changes.

rules.description: Review cross-cutting concerns like auth, logging, monitoring
rules.instruction: Ensure auth is consistent across layers. Add logging for debugging. Monitor key metrics.

rules.description: Orchestrate specialized agents for specific tasks
rules.instruction: Delegate to backend, frontend, testing agents for specialized work. Aggregate results.

rules.description: Summarize context before passing to other agents
rules.instruction: Create concise summaries of decisions and changes. Highlight action items for other agents.
